interface.longDescription: Finnish family and inheritance law for everyday situations: the property relations of marriage and the division of matrimonial property (avioliittolaki 234/1929), the position of a cohabiting partner (26/2011), the custody of a child, contact and maintenance (361/1983 and 704/1975), succession, wills and the compulsory share (perintökaari 40/1965), and guardianship and continuing powers of attorney (442/1999 and 648/2007). The best interests and the safety of the child come first; taxes from the source.
